newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Banca San Paolo di Brescia ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banca San Paolo di Brescia ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it affirmed Banca San Paolo di Brescia's long-term and short-term ratings of A and A1 respectively.
"The individual rating of B/C and legal rating of 4 have also been affirmed," IBCA said in a statement.
Banca San Paolo di Brescia is deeply rooted in its home province of Brescia, where it has strong market shares in funding and lending, IBCA said.

"The bank intends to extend its operations by expanding the number of branches outside the province and by using sales agents," the agency said. "Asset quality is good, reflecting the prudent selection of borrowers by the bank, and the generally healthy local economy."
Despite increasing competition from other banks, Banca San Paolo has achieved sound levels of profitability and expects its performance in 1996 to match that of 1995, IBCA said.
"The bank is well capitalised, with tier 1 capital of over 12 percent at June 1996," IBCA said.
